hudson_obrien2013: On Day 10, Gustav Obrien arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

An empty jam tin became Gustav Obrien's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. Grey Mill has been won. Gustav Obrien listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Gustav Obrien carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Gustav Obrien won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in Q-F23. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Gustav Obrien was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F23. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah). The bearers reached Gustav Obrien at Q-F23 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah).
The House of Obrien sent another. Ivo Obrien, father of Gustav Obrien, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Ivo Obrien dreamt he was back in Varenne, working as a bookbinder. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Ivo Obrien began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
ilpappa_dinomebatticulo: In Kesselby, Matthias Dinomebattic was a carpenter. In T-F19, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a carpenter again.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Matthias Dinomebattic's ear at T-F19 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Yann Thesenorfry of the Concord (@thesenorfry). Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Matthias Dinomebattic helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Matthias Dinomebattic rejoined the squad at T-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
A newspaper reached Matthias Dinomebattic with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Matthias Dinomebattic heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.
Matthias Dinomebattic thought about an old father who runs the family shop alone on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Matthias Dinomebattic fired at a movement across the wire at T-F19. The man went down: Ulrich Yeti, grazed.
jacckk_w: Tobias Jacckk unpacked a cracked shaving mirror at S-R3. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Tobias Jacckk's ear at S-R3 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Cyril Bmx of the Hegemony (@ian_bmx_51). News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R3 with the rations. Tobias Jacckk ate while listening to the revised orders.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Jacckk was watching at S-R3 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008). Tobias Jacckk got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 967. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Tobias Jacckk heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Tobias Jacckk drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Tobias Jacckk survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-R3, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
A round went through the rim of Tobias Jacckk's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dorian Caleb of the Hegemony (@ya_man_caleb).
The medics cleaned Tobias Jacckk's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R3.

A bullet found Tobias Jacckk at S-R3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008). Tobias Jacckk looked over the parapet at S-R3 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008).
Another member of the House of Jacckk reached the line: Leopold "Ash" Jacckk. He asked where Tobias Jacckk had slept, then chose a different corner.
jaceaustin_94: By the time Wendel Jaceaustin reached R-C5, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Jaceaustin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Wendel Jaceaustin had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Wendel Jaceaustin got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 763. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C5 with the rations. Wendel Jaceaustin ate while listening to the revised orders.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C5. Wendel Jaceaustin fired at the last man to run. Rafael "Owl" Dooley was grazed.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Wendel Jaceaustin gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
An empty jam tin became Wendel Jaceaustin's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
The blast lifted Wendel Jaceaustin off his feet at R-C5. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work.
The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel Jaceaustin's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C5 the same hour.
jaze96: Quentin "Button" Jaze left a girl from the dance hall, maybe behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a pressed cornflower. The men noticed at once that he hates silence more than shelling.
Quentin "Button" Jaze measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
The wind tore a sheet of corrugated iron off the dugout roof at N-F18. Quentin "Button" Jaze chased it halfway down the communication trench.

Machine-gun fire swept N-F18. Quentin "Button" Jaze took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno "Saint" Dir of the Hegemony (@alex_rose_dir). Quentin "Button" Jaze stood up to fix a loose sandbag at N-F18. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Zeno "Saint" Dir of the Hegemony (@alex_rose_dir).
The papers connected Norbert Jaze to Quentin "Button" Jaze. The men took longer to learn Norbert Jaze's own habits, but they made the effort.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Norbert Jaze aimed a step ahead and fired: Tobias Bubonicplagu, grazed.
kcharlesc2027: The draft reached S-C13 on Day 9. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Fresh from training, Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Oskar Rykerfallion, grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc transferred to the sappers. The men in S-C13 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

A man asked Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc to describe Dunmarrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 715. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc fell asleep on watch. Lucien Gloose took over without waking Owl, and told the sergeant nothing. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close.

Lucien Gloose taught Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F5 is up. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Blackwater Canal and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him. A letter from home found Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc before the night shift. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Bastian "Owl" Kcharlesc got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
m4ker: The new lieutenant gave his name as Leopold Ker. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Leopold Ker hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
New laces made Leopold Ker's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F20 with the rations. Leopold Ker ate while listening to the revised orders.
Florian Monkey and Leopold Ker made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Leopold Ker sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
Leopold Ker reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F20 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008).
Leopold Ker's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F20 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F20. Leopold Ker has learned to walk bent double.

An officer heard about the singing and forbade it. Tonight Leopold Ker only whistled the first bar. Across the wire, someone whistled the last. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold Ker is number 301 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Leopold Ker read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet clipped Leopold Ker's helmet at S-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz of the Hegemony (@chrisoostuizen).
Back on the fire step at S-F20. Leopold Ker says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Leopold Ker and Severin Guy have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
A round went through the rim of Leopold Ker's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong of the Hegemony (@sumtingwong7218).
Leopold Ker rejoined the squad at S-F20. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
maliklee05: Ulrich Maliklee came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. Ulrich Maliklee walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Ulrich Maliklee asked if second helpings depended on the answer. The transfer made Ulrich Maliklee a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Ulrich Maliklee of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Ulrich Yeti kept the tin. A letter from home found Ulrich Maliklee before the night shift. Ulrich Maliklee folded it small and kept it close.
Ulrich Maliklee drew a map of Hugo Paulgavin's hometown from Hugo's stories. Hugo says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

Ulrich Maliklee carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. A letter from home found Ulrich Maliklee before the night shift. Ulrich Maliklee folded it small and kept it close.

At U-F21 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Ulrich Maliklee turned around and took a shovel blow. Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord (@sea_ofsoup).
marco.n.enriquez: Ivo Enriquez stepped off the supply cart at S-R4 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Ivo Enriquez listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Ivo Enriquez remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. A letter from home reached Ivo Enriquez before dusk. Ivo Enriquez read it twice and slept a little easier. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Ivo Enriquez during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Ivo Enriquez fired, and Bram Tephydraws was badly wounded.

Ivo Enriquez was buried by a near miss at the Drowned Farm and dug out with a broken arm and a chest full of earth. A letter from home reached Ivo Enriquez before dusk. Ivo Enriquez read it twice and slept a little easier.

No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Ivo Enriquez recovered anyway and is back at S-R4. A letter from home reached Ivo Enriquez before dusk. Ivo Enriquez read it twice and slept a little easier.

The gun crews at S-R4 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Arno Guacamole was grazed. Ivo Enriquez had just lit a cigarette at S-R4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Roland Maccerny of the Concord (@maccerny808). A letter from home reached Ivo Enriquez before dusk. Ivo Enriquez read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ivo Enriquez came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The letter for Ivo Enriquez had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Ivo Enriquez dried it by the stove, page by page.
marek.bohme: In Ashford Vale, Leopold Bohme was a tailor. In P-F1, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a tailor again.
Leopold Bohme agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The artist tried again while Leopold Bohme read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Leopold Bohme in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F1. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers.

The bearers moved Leopold Bohme's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Bohme. Leopold Bohme read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
There was no room for Leopold Bohme. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
The House of Bohme sent Anselm Bohme after Leopold Bohme. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
natecartw: Ivo "Crow" Natecartw left five brothers, all on other fronts behind in Belmonte and came up the line with a dented harmonica. The men noticed at once that he sleeps with his boots on.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Ivo "Crow" Natecartw helped stack spare sandbags at S-R6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Ivo "Crow" Natecartw rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Valentin "Saint" Oliverjarret was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo "Crow" Natecartw is number 892. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ivo "Crow" Natecartw stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A round went through the rim of Ivo "Crow" Natecartw's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony).
Fever took hold of Ivo "Crow" Natecartw overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
Ivo "Crow" Natecartw returned to S-R6 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Ivo "Crow" Natecartw (Concord) and Jakub "Lucky" Sprite (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Sorrow Copse at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Ivo "Crow" Natecartw was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain.
notrealdi3d: By the time Rafael Notrealdi reached T-F10, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Notrealdi watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Rafael Notrealdi opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F10, Rafael Notrealdi listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Listening post, three in the morning. Rafael Notrealdi heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Rafael Notrealdi helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
A flare caught Rafael Notrealdi halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Rafael Notrealdi spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Rafael Notrealdi checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
pit_champion_orion: Albin Orion walked into R-C1 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Albin Orion helped stack spare sandbags at R-C1. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Albin Orion was hit in the forearm at R-C1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Isidor Hohlmike of the Hegemony (@hohlmike4). Albin Orion got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 787. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Albin Orion wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Albin Orion returned to R-C1 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Albin Orion set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.
Albin Orion cut Roland Machans's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Albin Orion held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.
Albin Orion mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
steinhoff.jacob: "You're late," said the corporal when Pavel "Tin" Jacob arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." Pavel "Tin" Jacob's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Pavel "Tin" Jacob had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Pavel Viaenegilles was grazed. A letter from home reached Pavel "Tin" Jacob before dusk. Pavel "Tin" Jacob read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F1, Pavel "Tin" Jacob listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Pavel "Tin" Jacob as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Pavel "Tin" Jacob read a theatre review while peeling supper.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Pavel "Tin" Jacob ate two helpings anyway.

A loose thread in Pavel "Tin" Jacob's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. A letter from home reached Pavel "Tin" Jacob before dusk. Pavel "Tin" Jacob read it twice and slept a little easier.
Pavel "Tin" Jacob agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
summer.l_21: Severin Summer introduced himself as a bookbinder from Stoneyford. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Severin Summer was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Severin Summer's hands still remember being a bookbinder's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Severin Summer mended the hole in Quentin Lebronmygoat's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Quentin says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Severin Summer. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.

Severin Summer threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Konrad Erikvukk was down and screaming for a medic. (@erikvukk) Night raid. Severin Summer crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Severin Summer. Severin Summer was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-S10. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Jonas "Owl" Askey of the Concord (@roman_askey_). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Severin Summer watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Nobody could reach Severin Summer in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.

A letter came with Konrad Summer: "I am Severin Summer's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The clerk counted the names twice. Konrad Summer is number 393 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Konrad Summer folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Konrad Summer and Marek "Button" Gergely tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Konrad Summer waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Konrad Summer felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S10. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string.
Konrad Summer walked back up the communication trench to R-S10, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Konrad Summer crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Pavel Hawkenram reached for a rifle. Konrad Summer was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@hawkenram) The Concord sentry, Bram Satalik, shouted once. Konrad Summer silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@jiri.satalik) Konrad Summer came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
tartochuk: Bastian Tartochuk came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Bastian Tartochuk let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Otto "Parson" Light was badly wounded. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bastian Tartochuk watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Bastian Tartochuk aimed a step ahead and fired: Casimir Hyniiiis, grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Bastian Tartochuk looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Bastian Tartochuk and Leopold Romania cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Bastian Tartochuk reached up to fix a sandbag at T-S8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Teodor "Owl" Passing of the Hegemony (@_a.stranger.in_passing). Bastian Tartochuk had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Casimir Hyniiiis was grazed.
Bastian Tartochuk rejoined the squad at T-S8. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Bastian Tartochuk across the shin at T-S8. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Gustav Bonie of the Hegemony (@mr_bonie3).
The medics cleaned Bastian Tartochuk's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-S8.
to_man58: "You're late," said the corporal when Marek Man arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Marek Man's ear at S-C10 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex of the Hegemony (@chivrex1945). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-C10. Marek Man has learned to walk bent double.

Marek Man no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Marek Man is number 624. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Marek Man watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Marek Man fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.
Marek Man fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-C10. Before dawn Roland Theelliottma walked into it, grazed.
A supply man offered Marek Man a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Marek Man fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Bram Somosmagios was grazed.

Machine-gun fire swept S-C10. Marek Man took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony (@sonofadeadmeme). Marek Man was killed at S-C10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony (@sonofadeadmeme).
Pavel "Hollow" Man joined S-C10 under the shadow of Marek Man's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
treasureplanetjimxzara: Nobody asked Ulrich Treasureplan why he came. Nobody in N-F22 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
vitto_roma07: Wendel Roma found a place in S-F7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Wendel Roma looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Wendel Roma added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
A bullet went through Wendel Roma's sleeve at S-F7 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Walter "Tin" Hansaazz of the Concord (@hansaazz).

Wendel Roma wore a fresh bandage at S-F7 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Wendel Roma did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Wendel Roma's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Wendel Roma spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Lantern Hill someone else was digging too.
Wendel Roma pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Calvary Farm and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.

A bullet went into Wendel Roma's chest just under the heart at S-F7. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo). Wendel Roma was hit at S-F7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo).
Another member of the House of Roma reached the line: Ivo Roma. He asked where Wendel Roma had slept, then chose a different corner.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F7 they left Ivo Roma behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Dorian Royalcanadia of the Concord (@royalcanadianmatt).
The papers say Bram Roma. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Ivo Roma's eyes. Nobody in S-F7 argues.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Bram Roma's ear at S-F7 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Tobias Connordavids of the Concord (@connordavidscott). Bram Roma got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 147. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Bram Roma folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Back on the fire step at S-F7. Bram Roma says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Bram Roma shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Bram Roma was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Bram Roma fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F7. Leopold "Whistle" Leh was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Bram Roma did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram Roma fired back. Henrik Youknowsomet was grazed.
yokiin: Nils "Lucky" Yokiin reported to V-F7 with a child's drawing of a horse sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
A rat stole Nils "Lucky" Yokiin's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.

The Concord raiders came over at V-F7 in the middle of the night. Nils "Lucky" Yokiin met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Marek Enjoyer of the Concord (@red3.enjoyer).
Another member of the House of Yokiin reached the line: Matthias Yokiin. He asked where Nils "Lucky" Yokiin had slept, then chose a different corner.
